verdict.rationale: Abacum documents scenarios (base, bull and bear) built off the same base version with connected assumptions in a governed workspace. It also documents a detailed edit history covering every edit event on data models, spaces and dimension mappings, which suggests an audit trail. However, nothing ties that history specifically to scenario assumptions, names the editor, or describes an auditable scenario comparison. Missing for 10: explicit per-scenario assumption records, documented user attribution of changes, an audit view for scenario comparisons, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
